response.text: The reversal is correct. Submitting the findings.

findings.evidence_sql: select l."JRNL_NO", sum(l."DR_AMT") dr, sum(l."CR_AMT") cr from "GLJRNL" l group by l."JRNL_NO" having sum(l."DR_AMT")<>sum(l."CR_AMT")
findings.summary: Journals 1361 and 1894 have debits exceeding credits (diff 36.00 and 27.00); expense debit overstated versus AP credit.

findings.evidence_sql: select l."JRNL_NO", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD", l."DR_AMT" from "GLJRNL" l left join "GLCOA" c on c."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD" where c."ACCT_CD" is null
findings.summary: Journal 1835 line 2 posts 10353.39 to account 5950, which does not exist in GLCOA.

findings.evidence_sql: select j."JRNL_NO", j."PRD_ID", j."POST_DT", p."END_DT", p."CLOSE_DT" from "GLJRNH" j join "GLPERD" p on p."PRD_ID"=j."PRD_ID" where p."STAT_CD"='C' and j."POST_DT">p."CLOSE_DT"
findings.summary: Journal 2485 (manual accrual) is assigned to period 9 (closed, CLOSE_DT 20241005) but POST_DT 20241022 is after close and outside the period dates.
Invoice 801 duplicates invoice 505 (same vendor, same INV_NO apart from trailing spaces, same date and amount 23367.74); both have separate journals, so the liability is booked twice.

findings.evidence_sql: select i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", l."CR_AMT" from "APINVH" i join "GLJRNL" l on l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" and trim(l."ACCT_CD")='2000' where i."INV_ID"=203
findings.summary: Invoice 203 amount 13158.62 does not agree with its journal 1345 AP credit of 13131.62 (27.00 difference); the journal is balanced but understates the invoice.

findings.evidence_sql: select p."PAY_ID", p."INV_ID", p."PAY_AMT", i."INV_AMT" from "APPAYM" p join "APINVH" i on i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID" where p."PAY_AMT"<>i."INV_AMT"
findings.summary: Payment 418 amount 7315.28 exceeds invoice 620 amount 7315.27 (1 cent overpayment) yet the invoice is marked paid.
